items.label: Meet Every Gardening Needs
items.value: our stakes for gardening come in a pack of 6, making them ideal for garden enthusiasts with a large plantation; This quantity ensures you have enough stakes to support all your plants; With a generous size of about 48 x 15.8 inches/ 122 x 40 cm, our plant stakes cater to a variety of plant dimensions and types

items.label: Adjustable Length and Half Round Design
items.value: plant cages supports are adjustable in length and, thanks to their half round design, can accommodate a range of garden layouts; Use them individually for single tall plants or link them together around shrubs for efficient use; These stakes have the flexibility to provide efficient support to your plants, irrespective of their size and shape

items.label: Experience Lasting Support
items.value: when using multiple stakes together, they can be inserted into the soil for about 3.94 inches/ 10cm and they will firmly stand on their own; When used individually, 7.87 inches/20cm insertion to the soil is needed for firmness; They provid a support for your plants need to grow upright and healthy; It's metal construction give durability and a long lifespan, reducing the need for frequent replacements

items.label: Simple Usability
items.value: these plant supports are easy to use; Just position them around the plant, and push the stake into the earth; Arranged as a single half or linked to form circles or rows, they cater to your practical supporting needs with effortless simplicity; Moreover, they are just as easy to store away during off seasons

items.label: Versatile Applications
items.value: our plant stakes for indoor plants, find application beyond just plant support; They are useful for creating plant boundaries or helping shape your plants and shrubs into desired formations; They are widely applicable and can be applied to your vegetable gardens, flowers, young saplings, peony, Monstera Deliciosa, tomato plant, orchid, rose and pepper, indoor potted plants, dense plants, tall outdoor plants and so on
